lines.en: What's, uh, what you're working on?
I want it to sound smart, but I don't know any big words or anything, so...
Well, why don't you use your thesaurus?
Here, you, uh, you highlight the word you want to change,
uh, go under Tools, and the thesaurus generates, gives...
gives a whole list of choices.
You can pick the word that sounds smartest.
No, no, I'm brainy, bright, clever.
Look out, ladies, Joey Tribbiani's got the whole package.
